title: Typed prescribed-groundwater-level inside-profile active-domain truncation
activation_rule: Execute only after LOW01-A live gate passes without modification to its source mapping or tolerances.

fixture.node_snap_tolerance_avoidance: Both controls are deliberately away from node elevations and the 1e-4 source snap guard.
fixture.forcing: One hydrostatic/zero-flux control plus one fixed small top-flux perturbation per groundwater level; forcing values are fixed before execution in the implementation record and are not tuned to outcomes.

research_route.method: research-only direct HeadCalc invocation with explicit reference_richards_state_binding, typed constitutive/top/source providers and immutable-origin replay; production request validator remains unchanged

gates: The independently derived NN equals the preregistered active Richards node count for each groundwater level.
HeadCalc completes without timestep reduction for the fixed controls.
For all nodes below NN, candidate water content equals cofgen(2,i) saturated water content within machine-scale bounds.
The bottom active-node gradient uses h(NN)/(z(NN)-gwlinp)+1 and the source-declared Jacobian stiffness Kmean(NN+1)/(z(NN)-gwlinp) is finite and positive.
The reconstructed saturated continuation heads below NN are finite and deterministic.
qbot is output from the complete vertical flux chain, finite, and whole-profile storage change closes against top, bottom and internal source/sink amounts within 1e-10 native length.
Repeating the same prescribed groundwater-level trial from an immutable origin reproduces NN, full pressure/water state and qbot within machine-scale bounds.
characterization_only: Magnitude/sign of qbot under the fixed top-flux perturbation.
Numerical iteration count and any difference between NN=2 and NN=3.
Profile shape in the saturated continuation.
forbidden: no alias of gwlinp to mode-5 bottom_head inside the profile
no HLINK04 activation from LOW01-B alone
next_if_pass: Execute LOW01-D transactional replay/rejection across accepted origin.
Characterize LOW01-C across node/profile-bottom branch boundaries.
Only after A/B/D pass and C is characterized reconsider HLINK04 activation.
